display.purpose: Hero headline only, one per page.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: Blue-tinted cast on card hover only; never present at rest.

motion.name: ease-out-state
motion.purpose: Default ease-out for hover lifts, border shifts, and nav transitions (~200-300ms).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action per view; carries the blue signal.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 10px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #2563eb; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action such as Download CV; a quiet tinted surface over the dark canvas.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #f1f5f9; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 10px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.28); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.14); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #60a5fa; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Content Card
components.description: Service and project card; flat at rest, lifts and borders blue on hover.
components.html:
Systems Architecture

Designing scalable, API-driven architectures for enterprise integration.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #10151f; border: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.14); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 0.25s, box-shadow 0.25s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); border-color: #3b82f6; box-shadow: 0 8px 32px rgba(59,130,246,0.18); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #f1f5f9; margin: 0 0 8px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #94a3b8; margin: 0; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Static metadata tag for project tech stacks; not interactive.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: rgba(59,130,246,0.12); color: #bfdbfe; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 8px; }

components.name: Section Eyebrow
components.description: Signature label: a blue vertical tick plus an uppercase tracked label opening every section.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-eyebrow-tick { width: 3px; height: 16px; border-radius: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #60a5fa, #38bdf8); flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-eyebrow-text { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #60a5fa; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Fixed top bar, transparent over hero, translucent blurred Ink Base once scrolled.
components.html:
JG
ServicesProjects
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 24px; background: rgba(10,14,23,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(148,163,184,0.14); } .ds-nav-logo { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3b82f6, #38bdf8); color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 14px; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #94a3b8; text-decoration: none; padding: 6px 12px; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f1f5f9; } .ds-nav-cta { background: #3b82f6; color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 8px 18px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #2563eb; }

narrative.overview: This is a dark drafting-table surface where structure is made visible. The palette is deep navy bordering on black, and the single blue accent behaves like linework on a blueprint: precise, deliberate, never decorative. Density is low: generous negative space, calm vertical rhythm, and a flat tonal hierarchy do the work that gradients and glow would do in a lesser portfolio. Depth comes from stepped navy surfaces and hairline borders, not from drop shadows. The aesthetic philosophy is restraint as evidence of seniority; the confidence is in what is left out.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy near-black canvas, flat by default
A single blue accent, used sparingly as a signal
Archivo throughout, hierarchy via weight and scale, not color
Tonal layering for depth; shadows only on hover
Wide negative space, calm rhythm, low density

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue is used on no more than 10% of any given screen. It marks exactly one primary action, plus links, focus, and hover. If blue is filling space rather than pointing at something, remove it.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Surfaces separate by lightness step (Ink Base to Surface Raised), never by a colored stripe or a heavy shadow at rest.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Emphasis comes from weight and scale contrast (at least a 1.25 ratio between steps), never from coloring a word. Headings stay in Text Primary.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat when idle. If a card has a drop shadow before the cursor reaches it, the shadow is wrong. Depth at rest is a tonal step plus a 1px border, nothing more.

dos: Do keep the page flat at rest; convey depth with the Ink Base to Surface Raised tonal step and a 1px Divider border.
Do confine Signal Blue to roughly 10% of any screen: one primary CTA, links, focus, hover.
Do drive hierarchy with Archivo's weight and scale contrast; keep heading text in Text Primary.
Do reserve the Hover Lift shadow for hover and focus states only.
Do hold body copy to a 65 to 75ch measure and give sections wide negative space.
donts: Don't ship the generic dev-template look: the interchangeable dark-blue gradient with glowing cards.
Don't dump the resume: no walls of text with every job detail exposed at once and no hierarchy.
Don't chase trend for its own sake: no glassmorphism, no neon-on-black, no motion without purpose.
Don't color a word for emphasis. Gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient) is prohibited.
Don't use a colored side-stripe (border-left greater than 1px) on cards or callouts.
Don't apply a resting drop shadow to any surface; flat-by-default is the rule.
